architecture: Two inference branches: Ultralytics YOLOv8n vehicle detector and Fast-ALPR plate detector plus OCR. CPU model assets are loaded lazily and snapshotted by digest. See the bundle descriptor for exact component and source hashes.

data.dataset_id: No reviewed model training/evaluation dataset supplied
known_coverage_gaps: Training data lineage and geographic/camera coverage are unknown for all bundled weights.
CAM-07 through CAM-09 footage is unavailable; the current sample set has no labeled plate-positive examples.
No reviewed train/validation/test manifest, plate labels, vehicle labels, or independent annotation audit is available.
License and redistribution terms for the component weights are unverified.
The OCR provider marks this exact MobileViT-v2 checkpoint as a legacy inference model; upstream scope is global, but Indian-plate performance is unmeasured by AI26.
data.manifest_path: evaluation/dataset-manifest.json (template only; no ready labeled manifest)
data.test_split_summary: No held-out labeled test set supplied. Runtime sample: 12 frames at 2-second strides from CAM-01, not accuracy-evaluable.
data.train_split_summary: For the selected OCR model, upstream documentation describes a global model trained on 85k+ plates from 65+ countries. This is a provider statement, not independently verified here; exact source manifest, split membership, and lineage remain unknown. Vehicle and plate-detector training manifests are not present in this workspace.
data.validation_split_summary: Unknown; no verified model validation split supplied.
data.vehicle_camera_location_session_separati: Not established for model training or validation; runtime clips are not a held-out labeled test set.

conditions: CAM-01 960x540, reported 25 FPS; 12 sampled frames at two-second intervals.
Two ONNX intra-op threads and one inter-op thread.
The source sample had zero detected plate candidates; no detector accuracy denominator exists.
Synthetic OCR timing used a generated in-memory crop and did not record OCR text.
evaluation.confidence_calibration_method: None. Configured confidence thresholds are operational cutoffs, not calibrated probabilities.
failure_cases: No positive plate detections in the 12-frame runtime sample; because frames were unlabeled this is not a measured miss rate.
Separate all-black synthetic OCR preflight returned AB251D, demonstrating that raw OCR text can be invalid; this is not a field error-rate estimate.
Legacy OCR ONNX emitted shape-merge warnings during load while inference session initialized.
evaluation.hardware: 12-logical-CPU Linux host; CPUExecutionProvider. Separate vehicle edge comparison was run on 12th Gen Intel Core i5-12450H; deployment target is unconfirmed.
limitations: No field accuracy, recall, precision, exact-plate match, false-read, or calibration measurement is available.
The companion edge benchmark measures agreement and latency on unlabeled local clips only; it is not target-device validation or accuracy evaluation.
Runtime sample does not measure six-camera shared scheduling, full capture-to-display latency, or field conditions.
Hashed weights establish byte identity, not trusted authorship, training lineage, annotation quality, or model correctness.
Upstream model-reported coverage/benchmarks are not AI26 measurements and do not establish accuracy on the bundled footage or Indian plates.

intended_use: Research and operator-reviewed traffic observations in the AI26 demonstration. Outputs are not a sole basis for enforcement, identity decisions, or other consequential action.
out_of_scope_uses: Unreviewed identity matching or watchlist action
Claims of calibrated confidence or accuracy
Use outside the camera, geography, lighting, weather, and image-quality conditions represented by a future reviewed evaluation

pipeline.postprocessing: Vehicle class filter and confidence threshold; plate detection and OCR; plate-format normalization; OCR confidence and format checks; per-camera association and review-only per-track consensus. Exact code digests are in the bundle descriptor.
pipeline.preprocessing_id: Versioned inference implementation in the bundle descriptor; YOLO 640x640 RGB BCHW float32 [0,1] benchmark input; Fast-ALPR library preprocessing for plate branch.

release_decision.reason: Documentation card only. No reviewed labeled holdout, license review, or approved deployment thresholds exist; this does not approve production use or model promotion.

risk_controls: Exact asset and pipeline hashes are recorded in the bundle descriptor.
Plate results below 0.35 OCR confidence, with unsupported format, or ambiguous association are not treated as supported identities.
Synthetic/model smoke tests are explicitly separated from real accuracy evidence.
Use human review before consequential decisions; disable/rollback controls exist, but no model promotion gate has passed on held-out labels.
Software-package license declarations are separated from model-weight rights; do not redistribute or deploy the weights until their specific terms are established.
task: Detect vehicles and license plates in sampled camera frames, recognize candidate plate text, normalize text against supported Indian registration formats, and expose track-associated observations for review.

weights.format: Composite: PyTorch vehicle checkpoint, ONNX plate detector/OCR, YAML OCR configuration
weights.license: The inference-library code repositories declare MIT; weight-specific terms for all bundled model files are not explicitly verified. See evaluation/model-bundle.current.json external_references.
weights.path_or_registry_id: evaluation/model-bundle.current.json (composite bundle descriptor; not a single checkpoint)
